summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the mill. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.

evidence.text: Kanya, Ek and Chai live in the south row.
In this village, red clay is found only along the old mill path.
The next morning, Anan was seen with muddy boots.
Anan was at the tavern from 11 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Rin was at the forge from 11 pm until 4 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Only Tawan, Anan and Rin live in the west row of houses.
Tawan was at the shrine from 8 pm until 11 pm; three neighbours confirm it.
Nobody can say where Ek was after 11 pm.
Chai says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Investigators found red clay at the mill.
The old herbalist was found dead at the mill. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Rin's lantern was found near the mill the next morning; Rin says it was lent out days ago.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Ek had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
The old mill path runs past only one row of houses: the west row.
Kanya was at the weaver's hall from 11 pm until 4 am; the priest confirms it.
